conviction_note: The findings sum to +1.3: a mild lean from an unannounced expansion lease the company called 'near term' ten weeks ago, a fit-out-driven revenue beat this name has not been paid for, and a 22%-short book after a 24% sector-driven month. The scaled number is (2*53/100-1)*11 = +0.66, smaller than the sum because the bar is disputed ($116m vs $135m), beats have been sold (FQ3 +69% beat went -8.0%, FQ4 +61% beat went +0.9%) and the skew already pays for upside. abs_move is set above the 9.97% event-implied move because of the crowded short and this name's 31-36% tails.
bar: Disputed: FQ1 FY27 revenue consensus about $116m (TradingKey, https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262201410-applied-digital-apld-stock-forecast-october-6-2026) against about $135m (Yahoo/Motley Fool 2026-10-02, https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/applied-digital-revenue-likely-plunge-210714070.html; scanx $134.86m, https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/applied-digital-q1fy27-results-analysts-forecast-134-86-million/52146664). EPS consensus about -$0.30. There is no company revenue guide. Every finding that depends on the bar is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 57.86m shares, 21.94% of float, 4.1 days to cover, settlement 2026-09-15, down 1.0% from 58.43m on 2026-08-31 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/APLD/short-interest/). That is a crowded short. Baseline skew_25d is -2.93 vol points, so calls are bid over puts and the priced lean is 'upside paid'. Put/call OI 0.73. The stock is -11.8% over 20 days and -51.8% from its 52-week high, after a sector-wide AI-hosting selloff with no company-specific news (24/7 Wall St, 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-28).

findings.finding: On the 2026-07-27 call management said ~250MW of expansion leases with two existing investment-grade tenants (100MW at Polaris Forge 2, 150MW at a Delta Forge campus, 'over $6 billion' of contracted revenue at 'materially higher rates') were in advanced negotiation and expected 'in the near term'. In the 72 days since, EDGAR shows no 8-K at all, so either the leases are being held for the print (the Delta Forge 2 lease was first disclosed in the FQ4 release) or they are slipping.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FQ4 print (2026-07-27), which carried a new 210MW/$5.2bn Delta Forge 2 lease in the release, moved +0.93% (baseline). Earlier prints with lease or financing news moved +31.0% (2025-07-30) and -35.9% (2025-04-14).
findings.why_not_priced: The talks themselves are public. What is not priced is whether they close at this print. If the market expected an announcement on the night, the stock would not have fallen 24% in a month on sector beta, and skew would be more strongly call-bid than -2.9. If it expected a slip, the 22% short would be building rather than flat to down.
findings.independence: EDGAR filing list (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001144879&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40) shows no 8-K between 2026-07-27 and 2026-10-07. The 'advanced talks for ~100MW and 150MW' line is restated in Yahoo's 2026-10-02 preview (same underlying call).

findings.finding: Revenue excluding fit-out lands at or above both consensus figures on the company's own run-rates: base rent was $44.1m/quarter at 100MW in FQ3 and FQ4, Building 2 Phase 1 (75MW) went live 2026-06-30 (about $66m for FQ1), data-center hosting has been flat at $37.3-37.5m, cloud at $18.1-18.4m, and tenant recoveries $6.5-8.1m. That totals about $130m before any tenant fit-out revenue, which was $18.9m in FQ3 and $152.4m in FQ4 while Building 2 Phase 2 was under construction through the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FQ3 FY26 beat revenue consensus by 68.7% on fit-out and the stock moved -7.99% (2026-04-08). FQ4 beat by about 61% and the stock moved +0.93% (2026-07-27). Fit-out revenue beats have not been paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews anchor on 'revenue will plunge' from $258.7m (Yahoo 2026-10-02) to a $116-135m bar that implies little or no fit-out. A priced beat would show as previews sitting near $150m+. It is a pass-through, low-margin line, though, and the market has twice declined to pay for it.
findings.independence: FQ3 segment split from a different release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1144879/000114487926000029/apldq326earningsrelease.htm). The Building 2 Phase 1 date is from the company's 2026-07-01 release (https://finviz.com/news/365473/applied-digital-delivers-second-building-at-polaris-forge-1). The arithmetic is mine, so this is an inference from company documents.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-02 Polaris Forge 1 reached Ready for Service on another 75MW (Building 2 Phase 2), taking live capacity to 250MW, inside the calendar-2026 schedule the company gave. The stock fell 4% on the day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Delivery announcements have not moved the stock up: -4.3% on the 2026-10-02/05 announcement as the sector fell (pluang 2026-10-05).
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: public for five days and on schedule. The residual is that the call can put a forward base-rent run-rate on 250MW live, toward the '$1bn NOI run-rate a year from now' target.
findings.independence: https://pluang.com/en/news-feed/applied-digital-turun-4-persen-meski-tambah-kapasitas-75-mw (2026-10-05), a different outlet reporting the same company release.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-25 a POSASR registered 24.56m more resale shares for B. Riley's Series G equity line. Of the $2.0bn commitment, $1.165bn is drawn (60.6m shares issued) and $835m remains, registered at the $34.00 floor, which sits above the $23.93 spot. The board can lower the floor at its discretion down to $4.48, so the remaining equity can only be tapped by re-pricing below market. The money funds construction of capacity leased under about $36bn of contracts, with about $600m of capex guided for the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Earlier prints carrying lease or financing news moved +31.0% and -35.9% (baseline). The 2026-09-28 selloff was attributed to financing costs: 'Financing costs remain the variable most likely to swing Applied Digital stock' (24/7 Wall St).
findings.why_not_priced: It is a resale-shelf amendment, not wire copy. If the overhang were priced, short interest would be rising into it, and it fell 1% to 2026-09-15. Signed zero after the rule-4 question: the money buys contracted, investment-grade-leased capacity, so the ramp is corroborated.
findings.independence: Commitment increase from $1.59bn to $2.0bn in the 2026-06-26 Sixth Amendment (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1144879/000149315226044312/ex10-7.htm). That is the same filing package, so it counts once.

findings.finding: 21.94% of float is short (4.1 days to cover) on a stock down 24% in a month on a sector-wide AI-hosting and rates selloff with no company-specific cause. Jones Trading initiated at Buy with a $70 target on 2026-09-28 and the stock still fell 6%. Any lease or financing upside at the print meets a crowded short.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name's prints are fat-tailed: +31.0%, +16.1%, +8.1% and -35.9% in the last seven (baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced: skew is -2.9 (upside paid). If the squeeze were fully priced, the straddle would sit well above the 9.97% event move, and short interest would already be covering faster than -1% per period.
findings.independence: https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/09/28/applied-digital-falls-6-despite-70-buy-initiation-at-jones-trading-terawulf-and-core-scientific-drop-4/ and https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/09/15/applied-digital-falls-4-and-turns-negative-for-the-year-as-the-ai-buildout-trade-bleeds-out-core-scientific-drops-5-cipher-mining-sinks-4/ establish that the drawdown was sector-driven.

findings.finding: Insider selling continued: a co-founder's stake dropped by nearly 50,000 shares worth $1.3m (reported 2026-09-18), with a Form 144 on 2026-08-04 and further Form 4s through 2026-10-05.
findings.why_not_priced: It is small against a roughly $7bn market cap and about $400m of daily turnover, and largely priced. It is filed because it is a sourced fact, not because it moves the print.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR 8-Ks since 2026-07-27: none (no standalone lease, financing or material-event 8-K before the print)
DEF 14A 2026-09-25: routine proposals only (directors, auditor, say-on-pay, adjournment). No authorized-share increase or reverse split. Meeting 2026-11-04, outside the window
CoreWeave (Polaris Forge 1 tenant): latest public is its Q2 2026 print (backlog $104bn, guidance raised, capacity sold out). Nothing since that signals a stress on APLD's lease
Peer lease flow (TeraWulf/Anthropic July 2026, Cipher Q1 2026): demand backdrop intact, nothing dated after APLD last spoke that changes its bar
Search for a 2026 announcement of the 100MW PF2 / 150MW Delta Forge expansion leases: none found

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly positive and agree with the skew (upside paid) but cut against the -11.8% 20-day run-up. The agreement with the skew means the positive lean is partly priced, which is why p_up sits only 3 points above 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 4 (financing is a question): the Series G equity-line overhang went from -0.5 to 0.0, because the money funds construction of capacity leased under about $36bn of investment-grade contracts, so the ramp is corroborated
Rule 5/7 (positioning is the thing to beat, not a finding by itself): the crowded-short finding went from +1.0 to +0.5, because the skew already pays for upside
Rule 6 (inside the guided range): the 75MW RFS on 2026-10-02, on the calendar-2026 schedule, went from +0.2 to +0.1
Rule 1/6 (beats sold, disputed bar): the revenue-beat finding stays at +0.3, already capped small. p_up went from 54 to 53
Not from LESSONS: a sourced insider-sale fact (-0.1) was filed on re-reading the set under the core's 'file what you found' rule. It was in my notes but not in the frozen draft
Left standing: the expansion-lease finding (+0.5) and abs_move_pct 11
